gap_found_by_this_task: normalize() repaired five kinds of damage silently: a non-finite panel size, a panel size outside its bounds, a non-finite or missing floating rectangle, a floating rectangle below the minimum, and non-dense menu orders. Its own contract says 'Diagnostics are user-visible warnings, never silent data loss', and the L3 negative oracle asks for an ignored panel id to be reported with a warning.
The item therefore adds one diagnostic line per repair, with the same wording style as the existing unknown-key lines.
reuse_decision: ADAPT the stable-key/container-size idea from qymcad-shell and the store idea from gui.rs; ADD the OM9 layout file, its schema gate and its repair diagnostics.
